from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported value for the target financial metric."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/stock code of the company")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric as written in the report")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the value")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of this financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
